item.title: Lin Chao-chi (林朝棨)
item.description: Lin Chao-chi (林朝棨) Lin Chao-chi (林朝棨) was a renowned Taiwanese geologist, best known for discovering the 十三行遺址 (Shihping Archaeological Site), one of Taiwan’s most significant archaeological sites.

item.title: Lin Chao-quan (林朝權)
item.description: Lin Chao-quan (林朝權) Lin Chao-quan (林朝權, 1900s–1980s) was a Taiwanese sports leader and democratic activist, best known as the second cousin (二舅/二叔) of biochemist 廖述宗 (Liao Shu-zong).

item.title: Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙)
item.description: Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙) Lin Qiong-xian (林瓊仙) was a prominent member of the Fengyuan family and the mother of biochemist 廖述宗 (Liao Shu-zong).

item.description: Shawna Yang Ryan (楊小娜) Shawna Yang Ryan (楊小娜) is a Taiwanese American novelist whose debut novel Green Island (《綠島》) won the 2017 American Book Awards.
